scope: All reactor src/main/java .java files from baseline module/exclusion rules; no filename filter.
limitations: Parse-only: imports and AST receiver chains provide syntactic evidence, not symbol/type resolution or semantic validation.
Routes are source registration candidates, not complete APIs or proof of runtime registration, reachability, permissions or OpenAPI coverage.
Literal paths, same-class static-final string constants/concatenation, inline path/nest callbacks and unambiguous private RouterFunctions.Builder helpers are expanded syntactically.
SpringdocRouteBuilder HTTP calls retain the second argument as handler and the third argument as OpenAPI source expression.

Constant forward/qualified references, arbitrary computed paths, builder aliases/reassignment and control-flow semantics are not resolved; helper standalone scans may retain duplicate unknown-prefix candidates despite expanded call sites.
Predicate OR and arbitrary predicate combinations are unresolved; only accept/contentType AND refinements are recognized.
Handler references and declaration signatures retain source spelling; they are not resolved semantic signatures.
Gateway Java DSL and annotation mappings are unresolved candidates; gateway YAML/configuration, runtime/generated routes and WebSocket URL mappings are outside resolved scope.
Candidate discovery is syntactic and can include unrelated same-name calls; unresolved entries are never counted as resolved routes.
Offsets are zero-based UTF-16 with exclusive end; line/column are one-based javac positions.
